about_the_game:
Game nostalgia about the beautiful days of childhood and dreams of space. And, of course, about favorite toys. Each of us dreamed of becoming an astronaut and embarking on a space journey in our childhood... Perhaps this game will awaken your dreams.
Control a group of robots, plan moves, collect batteries, and avoid traps. This is a game about attentiveness and resourcefulness in a nostalgic setting of a child's dream about space.

Key features of the game:

  • 3 biomes

  • 24 levels

  • Unique mechanics of simultaneous control of a group of robots

  • Simple rules, but truly challenging puzzles

  • All images are hand-drawn

name: To Get There Demo
short_description: To Get There is a turn-based puzzle. Manage a group of robots, plan your moves, collect energy sources, and avoid traps. Simple and intuitive mechanics, but truly challenging levels that require attention and strategic planning.
